A '''diamond dolabra''' is a [[dolabra]] of the [[Diamond equipment|diamond]] tier, a pickaxe and axe crafted from four [[diamond]]s and two sticks.

=== Chest loot ===
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===
It breaks pickaxe and axe blocks at speed {{Value|Diamond Dolabra|miningspeed}}, one slower than the [[diamond pickaxe]] or [[diamond axe]], and obsidian, crying obsidian and ender chests at speed 35. It has {{Value|Diamond Dolabra|durability}} durability.

Matcha Flavoured adds beds, candles, cacti and honeycomb blocks to the blocks that axes break quickly.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/axe.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Value|Diamond Dolabra|damage}} damage at an attack speed of {{Value|Diamond Dolabra|attackspeed}}.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[diamond]]s. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting and smithing ===
{{Uses}}

It melts down into a diamond. It is a diamond axe by item ID, so it works as the base for electrum and adamant axes and dolabras.
